title: NC-PLUS-LOOPBREAK-IP-1: Record a dispatch outcome (success/failure) per attempt in D1 so LOOPBREAK-IP-1's rule can evaluate
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-LOOPBREAK-IP-1 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** Every dispatched item write in D1 includes an outcome field (success/failure) updated on each attempt
**Status:** open

Record a dispatch outcome (success/failure) per attempt in D1 so LOOPBREAK-IP-1's rule can evaluate

Triage: Outcome must be written by the dispatch code on each attempt; the doer can only touch backlog rows, not modify dispatch logic. Closing probe also needs a live dispatch. | first step: Locate the dispatch write path in the Worker code and add an outcome column default null, updated to success/failure per attempt.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
